command.liasmediaplayer.invalid_type: Invalid media type: %s. Use video, audio or image.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.age_restrict: This one can only be watched signed in, which the mod does not do. Open it in your browser.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.decode_faile: ffmpeg stopped part-way through. Retry; if it keeps happening, update the tools.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.extractor_ou: The site changed and this yt-dlp no longer understands it. Updating the tools usually fixes it.
The uploader has not made this available where you are.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.link_expired: The stream link has expired or the host refused it. Retrying resolves a fresh one.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.live_not_sta: This is a premiere or a scheduled stream. Try again once it is live.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.network.hint: The host could not be reached. Check your connection, then retry.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.no_audio_dev: No sound output could be opened. Check your system's sound settings, then retry.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.not_found.hi: The link points at a file that is no longer there.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.private.hint: Only its owner can watch this one.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.sign_in.hint: The site is asking for an account or a bot check. Open the link in your browser.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.timeout.hint: The site took too long to answer. Retry in a moment.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.tool_missing: yt-dlp or ffmpeg could not be found or downloaded. Check your connection, then update the tools.
It was removed, or the link points at nothing playable.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.unknown.hint: The tools reported the message below. Retry, or update the tools.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.unsupported_: ffmpeg cannot read this stream. Updating the tools may add support for it.

gui.liasmediaplayer.tooltip.copy_link: Copy the link (Shift: from where it is now)
key.liasmediaplayer.play_clipboard: Play the link on the clipboard
settings.liasmediaplayer.appearance.them: The palette every window, panel and list is drawn with.
settings.liasmediaplayer.chat.allowed_ho: Comma-separated hosts to accept, sub-domains included. Used by the allow list; empty means nothing is accepted.
settings.liasmediaplayer.chat.blocked_ho: Comma-separated hosts to refuse, sub-domains included (example.com, i.redd.it). Used by the block list.
settings.liasmediaplayer.chat.blocked_se: Comma-separated player names whose links never become playable. Matches anywhere in the name, so a rank prefix does not defeat it.
settings.liasmediaplayer.chat.hover_prev: Hovering a picture label in chat shows the picture. Off, a picture is only fetched when clicked.
settings.liasmediaplayer.chat.link_filte: Which chat links become playable: every one, all but the blocked hosts, or only the allowed hosts.
settings.liasmediaplayer.performance.ima: Texture memory the pictures of chat links and pinned windows may hold. The least recently seen go first.
This is graphics memory, shared with the game.
settings.liasmediaplayer.tools.auto_upda: Replaces yt-dlp at launch when it is more than 30 days old. YouTube breaks older versions regularly.
settings.liasmediaplayer.video.max_heigh: The tallest picture fetched and decoded, YouTube included. Lower is lighter on the CPU and the network.
settings.liasmediaplayer.windows.default: Where a window of a kind you have not placed yet appears. Once you move one, the next of its kind opens there.
settings.liasmediaplayer.windows.max_aud: Past this many, a new sound joins the queue of the front bar instead.
settings.liasmediaplayer.windows.max_ima: Past this many, the picture looked at least recently gives way.
settings.liasmediaplayer.windows.max_vid: Past this many, a new video joins the queue of the front window instead.
